title: Sounding the Black Box: Online Training of Embedded Neural Networks in Forward-Only Physical Simulators
abstract: arXiv:2611.31964v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hybrid physics-neural simulators embed neural networks in partial differential equation (PDE) solvers to model unresolved subgrid dynamics while preserving resolved physics and conservation laws. Because closure outputs feed back across time steps, single-step offline regression does not directly minimize multi-step rollout error, motivating online trajectory optimization. Solver backpropagation through time (BPTT) is the standard online solution when solver derivatives are available, yet many operational Fortran and C/C++ simulators expose only non-differentiable, forward-only interfaces. We introduce FORGE (Forward-Only Response and Gauss-Newton Estimation), an online framework that trains embedded networks from forward runs alone by decoupling exact network derivatives from black-box simulator dynamics. translated_title: 探测黑箱：在仅前向物理模拟器中在线训练嵌入式神经网络
translated_abstract: 混合物理-神经模拟器将神经网络嵌入到偏微分方程（PDE）求解器中，以建模未解析的亚网格动力学，同时保留已解析的物理过程和守恒定律。由于闭合输出会在时间步之间产生反馈，单步离线回归无法直接最小化多步滚动误差，这促使了对在线轨迹优化的需求。当求解器导数可用时，通过求解器进行的时间反向传播（BPTT）是标准的在线解决方案，然而许多实际运行中的Fortran和C/C++模拟器仅暴露不可微分的前向接口。我们提出了FORGE（仅前向响应与高斯-牛顿估计），这是一个仅通过前向运行就能训练嵌入式网络的在线框架，它将精确的网络导数与黑箱模拟器动力学解耦。第一阶段通过沿输出正交权重方向的低维高斯-牛顿步骤对滚动过程进行预热，以抵消多层……
tldr: 该论文提出FORGE在线训练框架，通过将精确的网络导数与黑箱模拟器动力学解耦，仅利用不可微分求解器的前向运行即可训练嵌入PDE求解器中的神经网络，从而突破了传统BPTT方法对可微分求解器接口的依赖。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces FORGE, an online training framework that decouples exact network derivatives from black-box simulator dynamics, enabling training of neural networks embedded in forward-only, non-differentiable physical simulators without relying on solver backpropagation.
